YouTube uploads · TikTok drafts

Your video.
Your final say.

Level13 Publisher helps its owner send original videos from a private Telegram conversation to connected YouTube and TikTok accounts.

01 / YouTube

Upload, then review

The first caption line becomes the title. The full caption becomes the description. Uploads are configured as private so you can check the video in YouTube Studio before making it public.

Open YouTube Studio

02 / TikTok

A draft in your inbox

Videos go to TikTok for you to finish. Open the inbox notification, add the caption and disclosures, choose visibility, and publish when ready.

This workflow does not automatically publish TikTok videos.

From Telegram to your accounts

  1. 01Connect your accountsAuthorize account access through Google or TikTok. Your platform passwords are never given to this service.
  2. 02Send a video and captionThe private bot accepts messages only from its configured owner and reports each platform’s upload status.
  3. 03Finish on the platformReview the YouTube video and complete the TikTok draft. An upload receipt is not a promise of public visibility.

Private access. This is an owner-operated tool, with no public registration or uploads on this website. Platform access depends on authorization, review, and account limits.
